_comment: Provenance for the local-only llama_server_extract/ binary. The binary is gitignored and never shipped in releases; this file records what the acceleration feature was last validated against. Runtime behavior is driven by the live --help probe in services/backend/llama-server-capabilities.js, never by this file. Refreshed 2026-09-01 from llama.cpp release b10749 (llama-b10749-bin-win-cuda-13.3-x64.zip + cudart-llama-bin-win-cuda-13.3-x64.zip); previous validated baseline was build 8846 (bcdcc1044), which had no draft-mtp.
